_note: Author lists and venues from the CV summary; DOIs and citation counts from Crossref (2026-09-17). `me` is the 1-based author position of Tung-Ming Yu.

journal.title: Integration of organic opto-electrowetting and poly(ethylene) glycol diacrylate (PEGDA) microfluidics for droplets manipulation
journal.summary_en: Combines organic opto-electrowetting with PEGDA microfluidics so droplets can be moved by patterned light inside a moulded channel.
journal.summary_zh: 將有機光電濕潤與 PEGDA 微流道整合，以光圖案在成型流道內操控液滴。

journal.title: Light-driven manipulation of picobubbles on a titanium oxide phthalocyanine-based optoelectronic chip
journal.summary_en: Projected light on a TiOPc photoconductor generates and steers picolitre bubbles on the chip surface.
journal.summary_zh: 以投影光在 TiOPc 光導層上產生並驅動皮升級氣泡。

journal.title: Concentration of magnetic beads utilizing light-induced electro-osmosis flow
journal.summary_en: Light-induced electro-osmotic flow concentrates magnetic beads with no moving parts.
journal.summary_zh: 利用光誘導電滲流濃縮磁珠，無需機械元件。

journal.title: Moldless PEGDA-based optoelectrofluidic platform for microparticle selection
journal.summary_en: Photo-patterned PEGDA structures replace moulds, so an optoelectrofluidic particle-sorting chip can be prototyped in minutes.
journal.summary_zh: 以光圖案化 PEGDA 結構取代模具，光電流體微粒篩選晶片可在數分鐘內完成原型。

journal.title: Dynamic manipulation and patterning of microparticles and cells by using TiOPc-based optoelectronic dielectrophoresis
journal.summary_en: An organic TiOPc photoconductor makes low-cost optoelectronic tweezers that pattern cells and particles with projected light.
journal.summary_zh: 以有機 TiOPc 光導材料實現低成本光電鑷夾，用投影光排列細胞與微粒。

conference.title: The integration of TiOPc-based optoelectronic tweezers and optoelectrowetting with frequency modulation
conference.summary_en: One chip switches between particle tweezing and droplet actuation by changing the drive frequency.
conference.summary_zh: 同一晶片透過切換驅動頻率，在微粒鑷取與液滴驅動間轉換。

conference.title: Characterization of HepG2 cells behavior in critical frequency domain on TiOPc-based optoelectronic chip
conference.cite: 15th Int. Conf. on Miniaturized Systems for Chemistry and Life Sciences, Seattle
conference.summary_en: Maps how HepG2 liver cells respond to optoelectronic dielectrophoresis across the critical frequency band on a TiOPc chip.
conference.summary_zh: 量測 HepG2 肝細胞在 TiOPc 晶片上、臨界頻率區間內對光電介電泳的反應。

conference.title: Integration of organic photo-electrowetting and poly(ethylene) glycol diacrylate (PEGDA) microfluidics for droplet manipulation
conference.summary_en: Conference version of the Sensors & Actuators B work on light-driven droplet handling in PEGDA channels.
conference.summary_zh: Sensors & Actuators B 論文的研討會版本：PEGDA 流道內的光驅動液滴操控。

conference.title: Organic photoconductive dielectrophoresis by using titanium oxide phthalocyanine for micro-particles manipulation
conference.summary_en: First demonstration of TiOPc as the photoconductive layer for optoelectronic dielectrophoresis.
conference.summary_zh: 首次以 TiOPc 作為光電介電泳的光導層。

conference.title: A novel optoelectrofluidic system for cells/particles manipulation and sorting
conference.venue: SPIE Optical Trapping and Optical Micromanipulation VII
conference.summary_en: Optoelectrofluidic platform that sorts cells and particles with light patterns instead of fixed electrodes.
conference.summary_zh: 以光圖案取代固定電極來分選細胞與微粒的光電流體平台。

conference.title: An adaptive bi-directional micro-pump by using light-induced electroosmosis
conference.cite: 14th Int. Conf. on Miniaturized Systems for Chemistry and Life Sciences, Groningen
conference.summary_en: Light-induced electro-osmosis drives a micro-pump whose direction and rate follow the projected pattern.
conference.summary_zh: 以光誘導電滲流驅動微幫浦，流向與流量隨投影圖案調整。

conference.title: Dynamic pico-liter bubble manipulation via TiOPc-based light-induced dielectrophoresis
conference.cite: 14th Int. Conf. on Miniaturized Systems for Chemistry and Life Sciences, Groningen
conference.summary_en: Early conference report of the picolitre-bubble work later published in Applied Physics Letters.
conference.summary_zh: 皮升級氣泡操控的研討會初版，後續擴充發表於 Applied Physics Letters。
